summary: Iteration 18 — Retest of the bhakti_items vs content_items collection resolver fix. CRITICAL iter17 bug is RESOLVED. Backend: new pytest suite test_iter18_bhakti_collection_resolver.py (8/8 pass) + iter16 regression test_iter16_unified_editor.py (12/12 pass) = 20/20 pass in 3.4s. All /api/content/items/:id, /verses, /publish-check, PATCH /status, POST /verses, PUT /content/verses/:vid, POST /audio endpoints transparently serve items whether they live in content_items+content_verses (Chalisa) or bhakti_items+bhakti_verses (Aarti). Verified end-to-end on real aarti item 69f1e1a77488457efddb02b7: created a TEST_iter18 verse → verse written to bhakti_verses and returned by GET; updated the verse via PUT /content/verses/:id → persisted; uploaded MP3 via POST /content/items/:id/audio → audio_sync.audio_url now present on the bhakti_items doc. 422 validation on fresh bare bhakti item (missing title/supported_languages/verses) correctly blocks publish. Frontend: /admin/arti-manager → clicking Edit (pencil icon on श्री गणेशजी की आरती row) now opens BhaktiEditorDrawer WITHOUT the 'Item not found' error; drawer shows AARTI category header, 'Edit · श्री गणेशजी की आरती', status published · 2 verses, all 5 tabs (Content / Verses / Audio / Audio Sync / Publish) render, mode-toggle correctly HIDDEN for aarti, Content tab loads with Title (Hi/En/Sa), Deity, Thumbnail, Supported Languages chips, Description populated. Chalisa manager page loads and renders rows (Hanuman/Shiv/Gopal/Bajrang etc.) — its edit icon uses a different attribute (no title='Edit') so Playwright selector timed out, but the backend regression test_chalisa_unchanged passes and iter17 already validated the full Chalisa drawer flow. No new console errors on aarti drawer.

context_for_next_testing_agent: iter17 critical bug (BhaktiEditorDrawer 'Item not found' for every non-Chalisa bhakti category) is FIXED via server-side resolver helpers at server.py:626 (_resolve_item_collections) and server.py:811 (_resolve_verse_collection). Reusable pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter18_bhakti_collection_resolver.py covers both collection paths (content_items and bhakti_items) through the same /api/content/items/* surface (8 cases, 1.8s). Combined with test_iter16_unified_editor.py the whole editor API surface is 20/20 green. Known sticky points for UI tests: ChalisaManagerPage Edit icon has NO title and NO data-testid — use `page.locator('table tbody tr button').nth(index_of_edit_icon)` or wait for main agent to add testids. AartiManagerPage Edit icon does have title='Edit'. Hanuman Chalisa header still shows cached 40 verses vs real 5 (pre-existing, non-blocking).
rca of the issue: iter17 RCA was correct: drawer talked to /api/content/items/* but bhakti categories list rows from bhakti_items. Main agent picked option (B) — backend transparent fallback. Implementation: every /content/items/* endpoint first looks in content_items, then in bhakti_items (via _resolve_item_collections), and performs writes/counts on the matched collection. Same for /content/verses/:id via _resolve_verse_collection over content_verses→bhakti_verses. This keeps the drawer API stable and unifies both legacy data stores. Test confirms: POST /content/items/:aarti_id/verses writes into bhakti_verses, PUT /content/verses/:bhakti_verse_id updates bhakti_verses, POST /content/items/:aarti_id/audio mutates audio_sync on the bhakti_items doc. No data bled into the wrong collection.
